title: The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is…
description: The AutomatorWP WordPress plugin up to version 6.0.9 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'your-message' parameter used in form_field tags. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users view affected email log entries. Exploitation requires an administrator to configure a public automation with a Send-an-email action embedding the vulnerable tag.
